title: The Yoga Sutras of Patanjali
author: Charles Johnston (trans)
description: Patanjali's concise teachings on yoga in Charles Johnston's translation. The text considers mental activity, disciplined practice and liberation, offering a foundational framework for concentration and contemplative self-knowledge.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB). Source text obtained from Project Gutenberg (https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/2526).
